note: Every event a game with the onGame analytics SDK can send. privacy.html and store-labels.md list exactly these. Edit this file, then the two texts follow.

events.what: a play session started, and whether it is the first one
a play session ended, and how long it lasted
active play time, every 30 seconds while the game is visible
which game screen opened, and the time spent on the previous one
which button or game object was tapped, by its name (never the tap position)
a level was won, with its score
a level was lost, and how far the player got
the player left a level before it ended
a level was still open when the session ended
in-game currency earned or spent, and where
a tutorial step was shown or finished
an ad was offered, shown or skipped
an in-game purchase was started, finished or cancelled
a rating or yes/no answer the player gave in the game
the player turned analytics on or off
a game-specific event: at most 8 numbers, yes/no values or short codes
